description: Generate a complete, on-brand LAUNCH KIT from one brief — a landing page + launch email + social posts + poster, all consistent. Auto-creates a brand (palette/fonts) if none is attached. Returns the set of preview URLs + project IDs. Takes ~3–8 min; streams progress. Pull any asset's code with sketchxflow_get_code (slug 'home').

ai_images.description: Generate AI imagery (default true). false = type/color/layout only.

brand_kit_id.description: Attach a saved brand kit (see sketchxflow_brand_kits). Omit to auto-create + save a brand from the brief.

image_model.description: Optional. Pin which model generates this design's AI images — a PAID-PLAN feature (Starter and above). OMIT IT unless the user asked for a specific image model: omitting uses the account's default (gemini-3.1-flash-image) and is the normal path. Passing it on a free plan fails the call. Valid ids: gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image (Nano Banana Lite — fastest and cheapest); gemini-3.1-flash-image (Nano Banana 2 — default; balanced quality and speed); gemini-3-pro-image (Nano Banana Pro — highest fidelity, ~2x the coins). This is NOT `model`: `model` picks the LLM that writes the page, this picks the model that renders the PICTURES in it. The two id lists are separate and passing one where the other belongs fails with a 400.

model.description: Optional. Pin which LLM generates this — a PAID-PLAN feature (Starter and above). OMIT IT unless the user asked for a specific model: omitting uses the account's default (gemini-3-flash-preview) and is the normal path. Passing it on a free plan fails the call. Valid ids: gemini-3-flash-preview (default — balanced quality and speed); gemini-3.1-flash-lite (fastest and cheapest; good for quick edits); gemini-3.5-flash-lite (lite tier, slightly stronger than 3.1 lite); gemini-3.7-flash (strongest layout/code quality per coin); gemini-3.6-flash (previous Flash generation; pin for consistency); gemini-3.5-flash (older Flash tier; costs more than 3.7 for less); gemini-3.1-pro-preview (most capable, 2M context; slowest and priciest). Stronger models cost more coins. Affects text generation only — never AI images.

prompt.description: The launch brief — what's launching, who it's for, the message, and any details (date, offer, link).

name: sketchxflow_launch_kit
title: Generate a launch kit (landing + email + socials + poster)
